en.name: Bennett
en.ability: A good player drunk , even if you died. Once per day, If you guess who it is (once per day), they become sober & you learn their role.

revisions.v1: A good player drunk , even if you died. Once per day, If you guess who it is (once per day), they become sober & you learn their role.

en.flavor: The key to a successful adventure is to do the opposite of what Bennett does.
en.otherNightReminder: If Bennett succeeds in finding a player who was drunk by his ability, remove his "drunk" marker and let Bennett learn the character of the player who was drunk by you.
